person_note: The novel alternates sustained base sections in different grammatical persons: Colby participates as a first-person narrator, while Beverly/Paige is rendered in third person. The Goodreads event passages independently expose both strands, and the official Random House whole-book guide states the structure explicitly. Dialogue and gnomic quotations were not allowed to vote through their conversational or universal pronouns. There is no credible contrary evidence; the only limitation is that the authorized prose excerpt covers the Colby opening rather than a Beverly section.
